title: The Bridge Whistle With No Train
central_conflict: the bridge warning whistle sounded though no train was approaching
decisive_choice: a gust through a loose ventilation pipe made the same tone
resolution: secured the pipe and confirmed the warning system still worked
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the bridge warning whistle sounded though no train was approaching before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they checked the signal lever but it had not moved; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a gust through a loose ventilation pipe made the same tone; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they secured the pipe and confirmed the warning system still worked, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Frosted Greenhouse Corner
central_conflict: one corner of the greenhouse froze despite the heater running
decisive_choice: a cracked vent let cold air blow directly onto the seedlings
resolution: sealed the vent and moved the seedlings until temperatures stabilized
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered one corner of the greenhouse froze despite the heater running before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they increased the temperature but only the center grew warmer; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a cracked vent let cold air blow directly onto the seedlings; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they sealed the vent and moved the seedlings until temperatures stabilized, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Parcel That Floated Upstream
central_conflict: a parcel seemed to travel upstream against the river current
decisive_choice: an eddy behind the old stone pier carried floating objects backward
resolution: retrieved the parcel from the eddy and marked the hazard for boaters
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a parcel seemed to travel upstream against the river current before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they followed the main channel but could not explain its movement; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized an eddy behind the old stone pier carried floating objects backward; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they retrieved the parcel from the eddy and marked the hazard for boaters, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
